value.rationale: A missing edge is the natural elementary bond-fault model for a cube network. It creates a universal period-six invariant subsystem from an otherwise nilpotent even-dimensional update, and generates period four from a period-two odd-dimensional system. The all-dimension Jordan classification and exact joint entry/period census reveal boundary sensitivity not implied by elementary cube rank alone.
